name: Ivanti Neurons — Managed Devices
description: Pull managed device inventory and patch compliance from Ivanti Neurons

steps.instruction: Log into the Ivanti Neurons portal as an administrator
Create a new API key with device read permissions. Copy the key value.

validation_request.error_message: Could not authenticate with Ivanti Neurons. Check your API key and tenant URL.

transform.expr: {'ip': record.get('ipAddress', ''), 'hostname': record.get('hostName', ''), 'fqdn': record.get('hostName', ''), 'device_id': record.get('deviceId', ''), 'display_name': record.get('hostName') or record.get('ipAddress', '')}

{'agent_version': record.get('agentVersion', ''), 'domain': record.get('domain', ''), 'is_managed': record.get('isManaged', ''), 'patch_status': record.get('patchStatus', ''), 'missing_patch_count': record.get('missingPatchCount', 0), 'last_scan_date': record.get('lastScanDate', ''), 'serial_number': record.get('serialNumber', ''), 'manufacturer': record.get('manufacturer', ''), 'model': record.get('model', '')}
